role: Junior Civil Drafter (rail and civil, Perth)
relocation_line: I will relocate to Perth for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi Technical Resources team,

My name's Marc. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'd like to start out as a junior civil drafter. Your Perth role is aimed at recent graduates, which is why I'm writing.

During the course I drew up roads, earthworks and drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. Before that, on building sites in the Philippines, I was the one checking the drawings against the work.

I will relocate to Perth for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
